text_to_image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 detailed warm natural daylight coastal romance-game CG environment, pale cream limestone, muted sage-green joinery, flowering plants and a distant blue bay. No people, animals or watermarks. A cream-stone cottage stands on the left, an attached sage-framed greenhouse with peaked glass roof on the right, connected through a door in the shared stone wall. The greenhouse contains a long oak table and rear sink; its right glazing faces the sea. Four landscape panels stacked vertically with narrow white gutters: exterior establishing from lane, closer oblique exterior from right, reverse view from inside toward the closed gate, and close oblique latch/material detail. Each view shows the same set with coherent architectural orientation, no text.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, environment continuity. Create a VERTICAL 9:16 MULTI-ANGLE production reference sheet of the SAME existing coastal greenhouse gate. Image 1 authoritative appearance, image 2 layout, image 3 only layout format. FOUR horizontal landscape cinematic photographs stacked in one portrait canvas separated by narrow white gutters, no text or border. Match original L1 warm luminous detailed romance-game CG. Panel1 exterior establishing from lane, exact original architectural handedness, cottage left greenhouse right, closed double sage gate and daisies. Panel2 closer exterior from slightly right along lane, closed gate in foreground, same cottage left and greenhouse behind, no mirror. Panel3 from just INSIDE courtyard looking toward same closed gate and outside lane, showing inside latch and hinges consistently, distant bay beyond lane/right; do not duplicate greenhouse behind lane. Panel4 close oblique material detail of the gate latch and sage vertical timber boards between dry-stone posts, white daisies and lavender, keep gate closed. Every panel a distinct meaningful viewpoint of ONE set. No characters, no tools, no fallen sign; this is stable pre-action environment reference. Spatial continuity: cottage on left, attached sage-framed peaked-glass greenhouse on right. Connecting door through shared cottage stone wall. Greenhouse main table lengthwise, plant bench along sea-facing right glass wall; sink/work bay at back near stone wall. Small planted courtyard in front, single short central flagstone path to greenhouse entrance. Low dry-stone front boundary with exactly one closed waist-high double sage timber garden gate, both leaves closed; two stone posts topped with daisies. Outside cobbled lane in foreground continuing along right boundary. Blank hanging wood sign on bracket immediately left of gate. Wisteria over greenhouse, white daisies and lavender along dry-stone wall. Sea and coastal village far beyond right, not water directly against wall. No people, no invented second gate or duplicated cottage. Consistent physical place across views. The plan is a concept inference rather than a survey; maintain original L1 facade appearance.
